Project Role : LLM Full Stack Engineer
Project Role Description : Develop and integrate applications with Large Language Models (LLMs) and other enterprise services. Leverage front-end and server-side technologies to develop APIs, implement DevOps practices, and optimize Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications.
Must have skills : React.js
Good to have skills : NA
Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required
Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary:
As a LLM Full Stack Engineer, a typical day involves designing and building applications that seamlessly integrate with Large Language Models and various enterprise services. The role requires balancing front-end development with server-side programming to create robust APIs and streamline DevOps workflows. Throughout the day, collaboration with cross-functional teams ensures the delivery of optimized Artificial Intelligence applications that meet organizational goals and user needs. Continuous problem-solving and innovation are key aspects of the daily routine, contributing to the advancement of AI-driven solutions within the enterprise environment.

Roles Responsibilities:
- Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
- Responsible for team decisions.
- Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
- Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
- Lead the design and implementation of scalable software solutions that integrate with AI technologies.
- Mentor junior team members to foster skill development and knowledge sharing.
- Coordinate with stakeholders to align technical strategies with business objectives.

Professional Technical Skills:
- Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in React.js.
- Strong experience in front-end development frameworks and libraries related to React.js.
- Knowledge of server-side technologies and API development to support full stack integration.
- Familiarity with DevOps practices including continuous integration and deployment pipelines.
- Ability to optimize applications for performance and scalability in AI environments.
- Experience working with cloud platforms and containerization technologies.
- The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in React.js.
- This position is based at our PDC2C - SEZ location.
- A 15 years full time education is required.




Qualification
15 years full time education
